messages:
Jordan L.: Hey team, saw a $12.50 toll charge on my corp card after last week's trip to SFO. I thought tolls were turned off for rental cars, can someone confirm?
Meredith (Finance): Can you paste the card transaction line and date? sometimes toll vendors post delayed.
Jordan L.: Sure — `2026-03-18 19:42 - FASTLANE CA - $12.50` plus attached pic of the rental receipt (uploaded). link: https://drive.redwood/scrnshot_toll.jpg
Sundeep K: I drove a rental too that week — policy is corporate covers tolls only if on the corporate card during booking. Did you pay with the corp card at pickup?
Jordan L.: I paid the rental on my personal card and later added the corp card for gas. The rental agreement has a line about toll processing through the rental co though. Not sure who ends up billed.
Meredith (Finance): Policy refresher: rentals must be on the company card or we need manager pre-approval for vehicle incidental fees. Toll companies sometimes bill the rental agency who then posts to whichever card is on file. We can dispute if it's a merchant mistake.
Camille R: @Meredith (Finance) if the company pays this, should Jordan submit an expense or do we ask the card processor for reversal?
Meredith (Finance): First step: Jordan, file an expense with the rental agreement + photo of the toll notice. Tag it `toll-dispute` and set amount $12.50. I'll review and either approve reimbursement or escalate to card team to dispute the charge.
Jordan L.: Filed it now — expense ID `EXP-20260318-987`. Attached rental agreement page and the toll screenshot.
expenses-bot: Expense EXP-20260318-987 received: amount $12.50, category: travel-incidental. Status: pending-approval.
Meredith (Finance): Got it. @Sundeep K — can you approve an exception if needed? It looks like Jordan didn't charge the rental to the corp card. If we approve, we'll reimburse then open a dispute with the issuing bank to recover funds.
Sundeep K: Approved. I didn't notice the card mixup at the time, my bad. Approving exception for this one-off. :white_check_mark:
Meredith (Finance): Thanks. Jordan — we'll mark as reimbursable. I'll submit a dispute with the card issuer to try and reverse the $12.50. If the bank recovers it, we'll void the reimbursement. Expect funds to hit your payroll card in 3-5 business days if not recovered.
Jordan L.: Appreciate it, thanks everyone. Quick Q — should I request the rental co to remove the toll post? or you all handle it?
Meredith (Finance): If you can email the rental CO and forward any confirmation to finance@redwood.com that helps, but we'll open the formal dispute in parallel.
Jordan L.: Will do, forwarding any replies here. :thumbsup:
Meredith (Finance): Closing loop: reimbursement issued on 2026-03-20, dispute opened same day with issuer (case #CARD-6543). Keeping thread for updates.
expenses-bot: Update: dispute CARD-6543 status = in_review.
Jordan L.: Got the reimbursement today, thank you — will update if rental co refunds later.
